entry_traversal.desc.enchantment.minecra: Removes the underwater mining speed penalty.
Deals 2.5 extra damage per level to arthropods.
The item cannot be removed once equipped, except by death or breaking.
Reduces explosion damage by about 8% per level and weakens explosion knockback.
Summons lightning on the target during thunderstorms.
Reduces underwater movement slowdown by about one third per level.
Increases mining speed per level, scaled by tool material.
Reduces fall damage by 12% per level.
Sets the target on fire for 4 seconds per level.
Reduces fire damage by about 8% per level and shortens burn time.
Ignites arrows so they set targets on fire.
Increases block drops and their chances per level.
Freezes water under your feet into frosted ice and prevents magma block damage.
Deals 2.5 extra damage per level to aquatic mobs.
Arrows are not consumed as long as one arrow remains.
Increases melee knockback per level.
Increases mob drops and rare drop chances per level.
The thrown trident returns to you.
Improves the chance of treasure from fishing.
Shortens fishing wait time by 5 seconds per level.
Repairs durability using collected experience.
Fires three arrows while consuming one.
Arrows pass through multiple entities.
Increases arrow damage by 25% per level.
Reduces projectile damage by about 8% per level.
Reduces most incoming damage by about 4% per level.
Increases arrow knockback per level.
Shortens crossbow reload time per level.
Extends underwater breathing by 15 seconds per level and lowers drowning damage.
Launches you in the direction you throw while in rain or water.
Adds 0.5 melee damage per level (+1 total at level I).
Blocks drop themselves instead of their normal drops.
Deals 2.5 extra damage per level to undead.
Increases movement speed on soul sand and soul soil per level.
Raises sweeping attack damage (50% at level I, 75% at level III).
Increases sneaking movement speed per level.
15% chance per level to reflect 1-4 damage when hit, at extra durability cost.
Reduces the chance of durability loss (level/(level+1)).
The item is destroyed on death instead of dropping.
entry_traversal.desc.enchantment.farmers: Deals 1.4x / 1.6x / 1.8x damage at levels I / II / III when attacking a target from behind (about a 120° cone).
entry_traversal.desc.enchantment.mynethe: Gives a 40% chance for sword or axe hits to act like a knife and grant Farmer's Delight hunting drops; can trigger failure events, conflicts with Looting, and cannot be removed by grinding.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.ba: Triggers a raid when entering a village.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.bl: Prevents sprinting and critical hits and heavily limits vision.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.co: Grants underwater breathing, night vision and mining speed.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.fi: Grants immunity to fire, lava and burning.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.gl: Shows the entity's outline through blocks.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.ha: Increases mining and attack speed by about 20% per level.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.he: Lowers villager prices and improves how villagers treat you.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.in: Restores health instantly; stronger at higher levels.
Hides the entity, though worn equipment stays visible.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.ju: Increases jump height and reduces fall damage per level.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.mi: Slows mining, more with each level.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.na: Warps the screen; it does not change player stats.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.ni: Lets you see clearly in darkness.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.po: Drains health over time but never kills.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.re: Regenerates health over time, faster at higher levels.
Reduces incoming damage by 20% per level.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.sl: Slows falling and prevents fall damage.
Decreases movement speed by about 15% per level.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.sp: Increases movement speed by about 20% per level.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.minecraft.wi: Drains health over time and can kill.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.farmersdelig: Restores 1 health every 4 seconds while saturation is empty; the effect level does not speed up healing.
Reduces hunger loss, letting you go longer without eating.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.farmersrespi: Increases movement speed by 10% and attack speed by 20% per level, and greatly delays phantom spawning.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.brewinandche: Wobbles the screen, drags the mouse, scrambles chat, and delays some damage; stronger at higher levels. Milk removes it.
Prevents gaining saturation from food; removed by milk or hot cocoa.
Melee hits grant 5% attack speed, stacking up to 4 times; each level adds 2.5%.
Restores 1 hunger every 20 seconds; higher levels restore it faster.
Consumes saturation to regenerate health over time; higher levels heal faster.
entry_traversal.desc.effect.mynethersdel: Deals damage over time and briefly ignites you near heat, lava, or while on fire; extinguishes itself at low health. Higher levels shorten the damage interval.
Restores health over time near heat or while on fire; requires fire resistance or fire protection gear, otherwise it turns into the harmful Pungency. Higher levels shorten the healing interval.
